Backtrack chained merge trees; minimal conflicting subset if impossible; require passing linked tests and clean local merges.

value.text: Behavioural revert proof: replaced only cleanOrder with input order. The real three-lane ordering regression failed with ERR_ASSERTION, exit 1. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1: investigate hosted-ref trust semantics, test explicit refused and acknowledged states, and return the largest deterministic clean landing order with blocked-peer diagnostics. Preserve nonzero partial-land exit.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Root cause confirmed in pinned SDK: GITHUB_HEAD_REF/GITHUB_REF_NAME override local Git branch for provenance and trust; CI=true alone grants nothing. Reproduced original untrusted assertion failure with matching hosted ref under isolated HOME/Git config. Tests now isolate source-workspace and hosted refs and separately verify foreign refusal, explicit acknowledgement, and host-contract matching-ref execution.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Candidate-tree regression exposed another inherited-environment issue: the verification subprocess inherited PM_SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT from the parent PM run and could snapshot the parent checkout instead of the simulated merge. Bind the child source workspace to the verification worktree. The existing merged-source assertion detects this behavior.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof: restoring only the pre-round landLanes implementation (plus its original import) makes partial-land regression fail, exit 1: order [] instead of the expected two-lane clean subset. Restoring only inherited child source-workspace behavior makes the existing merged-source regression fail with Linked tests failed, exit 1. Both changes restored exactly. Trust fixture reversion under CI=true/GITHUB_ACTIONS=true with hosted PR ref fails provenance assertion (hosted ref instead of authoring), exit 1; original /untrusted/ refusal assertion remains intact. Baseline original test also reproduced the runner command-execution failure.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1 PM-linked acceptance: pm test pm-swarm-jt6d --run --progress passed 2 linked command(s), 17 tests, zero failures. Full post-run snapshots unchanged: two registered worktrees, zero parallel branches, zero swarm Git configuration keys. Source, tracker and settings mutations remained inside scratch repositories.
